detail.longDescription: 🦖 ServiceWorkerRegistration: cookies property 🟧 Limited availability https:// developer.mozilla.org/en-US/do cs/Web/API/ServiceWorkerRegistration/cookies The cookies read-only property of the ServiceWorkerRegistration interface returns a reference to the CookieStoreManager interface, which enables a web app to subscribe to and unsubscribe from cookie change events in a service worker. This is an entry point for the Cookie Store API. # webdev
